analyst.summary: Kansai Nerolac just reported its best quarterly revenue growth in some time (up over 10%), backed by a healthy, debt-free balance sheet and a fresh capacity-expansion plan. The stock trades at a real discount to Indian paints-sector peers, reflecting genuine worries about new low-cost competitors taking decorative-paints market share, but the company's returns on capital remain solid and the valuation looks fair rather than demanding. We would hold rather than sell at current levels, while watching competitive intensity closely.
